item.description:
​
All audio ripped from Netflix, synced to the rips and encoded to AAC stereo by yours truly. Only the original audio track is in Surround sound (5.1).

Sponge on the Run's audio tracks on Netflix are not fully in sync to the BluRay, so some cutting and muxing on the intros (DW the process was not complicated or required any quality loss before I encoded to AAC) had to be done to get them to sync up with the visuals flawlessly. The only one that isn't perfectly in sync with the visuals is the Audio Description track, but its only affected on the intro of the movie and not the actual movie content itself.

The H.265 10bit video track of the movies itself were encoded by:
- Tigole (movies 1-3)
- PSARips (Saving Bikini Bottom)
- BONE (Plankton The Movie)
- NeoNoir (Search for SquarePants)

This will be updated in the future, if specific subtitle or audio tracks are eventually found by myself. Otherwise, this is mostly complete-ish and I don't feel like adding any more to these as it already feels bloated as is.

Due to me trying to save up storage space, only a LIMITED number of audio tracks were included (so, you will not expect all of them to be in here), but there are still a handful; and frankly I think its better than nothing, so hopefully it'll suffice! For movies 1-5, I only selected languages that likely have major presence in most piracy spaces, I had also used lists of older-audience and adult-animated content with dubs, and I think these are the most common languages of that selection. I am missing some audio languages on movie 6 also, but they will be added eventually if I can find or get them.
